newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: UBS upgrades S.Africa equities ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: UBS upgrades S.Africa equities ahead of budget.

text.p: London investment house UBS said it was upgrading the South African equity market ahead of next week's budget from an underweight to an overweight position and expected a rate cut in the second quarter of the year.

Another currency crisis, similar to the one in 1996 which saw the rand shed a fifth of its value against a basket of currencies, was unlikely with an improving trade balance boosting foreign exchange reserves.
UBS said its main stock picks would be interest rate sensitive shares and domestic recovery plays as the economy starts picking up in the second half of the year.
